ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the prevalence of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts to combat it
ideas.angle: Data analysis and interviews with experts
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and enforcement. By analyzing data and speaking with experts, we can shed light on this important issue.

ideas.title: FBI Investigations into White-Collar Crime
ideas.description: Examine the FBI's efforts to investigate and prosecute white-collar crime

questions: What are the most common types of white-collar crime?
How effective is the FBI in investigating and prosecuting these crimes?
ideas.insight: This story can provide insight into the FBI's approach to combating white-collar crime and highlight areas for improvement. By analyzing case data and speaking with officials, we can better understand the scope of the problem and the efforts to address it.
